values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753750 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0', 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753750 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a campsite, a concrete boat ramp, a toilet (type not stated) and primitive campsites; no drinking water listed. ADA accessibility rated 'Moderate'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753750 (Facilities: 'Campsite', 'Ramp (Concrete)', 'Toilet', 'Primitive Campsite'; ADA Accessibility 'Moderate Accessibility'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site (2.4 acres, ~3,390 ft) on the Missouri River with designated primitive camping. Directions (FWP): 7 miles south of Cascade, take Hardy Creek Exit 247 off I-15, then 2.5 miles south on Recreation Rd. FWP: 'Parking for boats trailers can be limited.' Not to be confused with the private Prewett Creek RV Park nearby. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping, campsite, toilet, concrete ramp, primitive campsites; added the 7-day stay limit. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: trailer length (none published; no review giving a 23-ft+ rig found), site count, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note trimmed of restated facilities, FCFS and fees; FWP's limited-parking caveat added.
